name: Wise
summary: Reads a Wise business profile's balances and their statements into Banking, read-only: each money account whose identifier is a Wise balance ID is fed hourly, and Wise's balance webhooks prompt an early sync.

capabilities.trigger_rule: The sync schedule: the tick's hourly bank.sync, or an early sync a verified Wise webhook prompts.

profile_id.title: Business profile ID
profile_id.description: The Wise business profile whose balances are read, as Wise shows it.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Wise's production, or its sandbox for staging.

history_days.title: History on the first sync
history_days.description: How many days before today the first sync reads, at most 469 (Wise's longest statement).

secrets.name: api_token
secrets.title: API token
secrets.description: A personal API token of the business account (Your Account › Connect and manage apps › API tokens). Fyniq only reads with it: choose read-only access if Wise offers it.

health_check: Counts Wise's refusals and failed connections in recent syncs, and each feed's last sync and why it stopped.
test_action: Lists the profile's standard balances, and reports whether Wise accepted the token.
local_substitute: A fake Wise in tests; Prism serves contracts/partners/wise.yaml in the local partners profile.
